about: Mix-and-match sections for interior design studios, architecture firms and bespoke-furniture/kitchen makers, from 12 Dribbble full-page references (1–12.webp; shot links in _sources.json). Every mockup = one base STYLE + an ordered set of SECTIONS. Crops live in sections/<id>.jpg. Beautiful room and project photography is the whole product here: use the lead's real project photos, renders and studio portraits first, then high-end interiors stock. Years, project counts, awards and client ratings must come from FACTS.
